goal: Speed up signature creation by using CPU hardware-accelerated SHA256 in elliptic curve operations
Cleanly decouple and manage cryptographic context initialization across node components
agreement: Tested with a differential test harness across 20,000 rounds of cryptographic operations (fametrano)
Broad concept approval for hardware-accelerated crypto (fjahr, ismaelsadeeq, sedited, theStack, w0xlt)
Suggests cloning the signing context to skip a redundant SHA256 self-test (fametrano)
Suggests removing a redundant SHA256 auto-detection call (w0xlt)
